title: bbox_bundle_evidence needs a compact summary mode
wanted_capability: Allow bbox_bundle_evidence callers to request compact entity properties or per-entity summary/property_mode so bundling broad knowledge refs does not dump full long content and spill to harness dump files during normal provenance grounding.
fallback_used: Implemented bbox_bundle_evidence property_mode support with summary/compact truncation and none/omit property suppression; live dev MCP smoke confirmed summary mode reports degraded.property_mode=summary and truncates the broad knowledge ref content instead of spilling the full body.
notes: In the sandbox probe, bundling knowledge:bb-tool-reference emitted the full global tool-reference content (~29KB) and spilled to a dump file even though the final answer only needed refs and compact support facts. Addressed by adding optional property_mode to bbox_bundle_evidence plus docs/preamble guidance to use property_mode="summary" for broad tool/knowledge refs.
